title: Missing X-Permitted-Cross-Domain-Policies response header
description: The response omits X-Permitted-Cross-Domain-Policies. The header governs which crossdomain.xml files legacy Adobe clients may read from this origin. Modern browsers stopped using the mechanism, so absence matters only while a legacy client still talks to the site; the finding documents an unset legacy control.
remediation: Send X-Permitted-Cross-Domain-Policies: none while any legacy client can reach the origin, and remove crossdomain.xml files that grant broad access. Where no such client exists, record that the header is unnecessary.
limitation: Header-name check on a legacy control. It cannot tell whether a legacy client still consumes the origin, so a modern-only deployment is reported exactly like a live one.
